title: Jonah Barrington
html_source: An Irish lawyer, judge and politician, (1760-1834) he is most notable for his amusing and popular memoirs of life in late 18th-century Ireland; for his opposition to the Act of Union in 1800; and for his removal from the judiciary by both Houses of the Parliament in 1830.
